atproto.handle: Your Bluesky handle (or another AT Protocol account)
atproto.siteUrl: Your site's address (https), where the note is published
atproto.password: An App Password for this account (Bluesky → Settings → Privacy and security → App passwords). It is used for this sign-in only and is not stored.
atproto.confirm.title: Publish publicly?
atproto.confirm.publish: “{title}” will be written to {handle}'s AT Protocol account as a public record. Anyone can read it, and relays and apps keep their own copies: removing it later can't take those back. Marked passages (<redact>) and hidden comments are removed first.
atproto.confirm.update: The public record of “{title}” in {handle}'s account will be replaced with this version. Copies relays already made of the old version stay.
atproto.unpublish.title: Remove the public record?
atproto.unpublish.confirm: The record of “{title}” will be deleted from {handle}'s account. Copies relays and apps already made stay.
atproto.removed: The record was removed from your account.
